column1: # LUAU-3 (review 2026-11-21): the exported type of a list of pointers is what
# the load stores. TestLuauListOfPointersTypeMatchesTheLoad generates the
# modules of Graph.schema and, for each row, passes the generated modules and
# the probe through luau-analyze (strict) and runs the probe.
# (A list of byte buffers, []*bytes, is refused by schema check, docs/SPEC-TABLES.md
# §15, so no table unit reaches that spelling.)
# the defect: a null element (false) and the live length (n)
